tasks.subject: Task 1: NFS Provisioner
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `nfs-subdir-external-provisioner` as a HelmRelease with Flux variable substitution for the NFS server address and export path, creating the `nfs-client` StorageClass.

**Verify:** `mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/` → no errors; `kubectl get storageclass nfs-client` → (default)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/infrastructure/sources/nfs-provisioner.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/nfs-provisioner/helmrelease.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/nfs-provisioner/kustomization.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/nfs-provisioner.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/nfs-provisioner/cluster-vars.yaml.example", "kubernetes/infrastructure/kustomization.yaml", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/ && kubectl get storageclass nfs-client", "acceptanceCriteria": ["yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/ exits 0", "kubectl get storageclass nfs-client shows (default)", "kubectl get pods -n nfs-provisioner shows Running"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: External Secrets Operator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Deploy ESO via HelmRelease so the cluster can generate and manage secrets in-cluster without any external vault.

**Verify:** `mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/` → no errors; `kubectl get pods -n external-secrets` → all Running

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/infrastructure/sources/external-secrets.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/external-secrets/helmrelease.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/external-secrets/kustomization.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/external-secrets.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/kustomization.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/ && kubectl get pods -n external-secrets", "acceptanceCriteria": ["yamllint exits 0", "kubectl get pods -n external-secrets shows all Running", "kubectl get crd externalsecrets.external-secrets.io exists"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: TimescaleDB
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Deploy TimescaleDB as a StatefulSet in the `database` namespace with ESO-generated credentials and a ClusterSecretStore for cross-namespace secret access.

**Verify:** `mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/` → no errors; `kubectl get pods -n database` → timescaledb-0 Running

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/infrastructure/timescaledb/", "kubernetes/infrastructure/timescaledb.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/ && kubectl get pods -n database && kubectl get clustersecretstore kubernetes-reader", "acceptanceCriteria": ["yamllint exits 0", "timescaledb-0 Running", "timescaledb-credentials secret exists in database ns", "ClusterSecretStore kubernetes-reader Ready"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Home Assistant
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Deploy Home Assistant in the `home-assistant` namespace with NFS-backed config storage, TimescaleDB as its primary database, and a Traefik Ingress at `homeassistant.homelab.lan`.

**Verify:** `mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/apps/` → no errors; `curl -I http://homeassistant.homelab.lan` → HTTP/1.1 200

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/apps/home-assistant/", "kubernetes/apps/home-assistant.yaml", "kubernetes/apps/kustomization.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/apps/ && kubectl get pods -n home-assistant && curl -I http://homeassistant.homelab.lan", "acceptanceCriteria": ["yamllint exits 0", "HA pod Running", "timescaledb-credentials secret exists in home-assistant ns", "curl returns HTTP 200"]}
```
